assets.sourceOriginalName: Jerrican Aqua-Tainer dans un halo rouge sci-fi.png
assets.alt: Concept illustration of a blue Reliance Aqua-Tainer 7-gallon container with red caps in a red inventory frame
assets.reviewNote: Blue 7G container, red caps and handle match the manufacturer family. The previous 22.7 kg / 50 lb side marking is absent. Reliance confirms a five-year limited warranty; the earlier objection to that marking is withdrawn. Seven US gallons is about 26.5 L; 26 L on the current page is rounding, not a different capacity. Fine print is illustrative, not an authenticated label. Exact Amazon variant remains unverified.
